name: automation
_doc: The Automation pack (owner request R-0239): 3 auto-* SPECIALIST agents for n8n workflows and chat bots in code (Discord, Telegram, Slack). Evidence: demo-sandbox-automation and web-design-booking-automation, named in the global per-domain policy (no brain entry). forge-router sends an automation request to this pack; forge-pack.cjs (doctor check packs) is red when a pack agent or skill is missing, unrouted or not a registered specialist. Presets are expanded by forge-lane-skills.cjs (--require automation-all,process). Workflows are imported inactive, credentials are metadata only, and activation, production instances and outbound messages stay owner gates. The n8n-* skills come from a plugin and are optional, never preloaded.
